title: Planetarium Commentary
premise: A commentary succession at the municipal planetarium. Axing and Achen look nearly alike and are easily mistaken; the celestial globe goes intact→gear-jammed→recalibrated; the commentary lift platform crashes and must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.

states.prime_on_duty: Chief planetarium commentator Gu Heng in his forties, neat short hair, deep-blue uniform jacket, a small Big Dipper badge at the collar, even speech, mild eyes.
states.weary_wounded: The same Gu Heng weary and wounded: uniform shoulder line worn through, gauze on the temple, Big Dipper badge still pinned, heavy steps.
states.stepped_away: Gu Heng has stepped away from the post; only his old deep-blue uniform and work badge remain in the planetarium—he himself no longer appears.

states.young_apprentice: Young Axing: a lean commentary apprentice of fourteen or fifteen, turmeric armband on the left sleeve, script under the arm, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Axing: a tall upright successor commentator in the twenties, still the turmeric armband, steady eyes.

states.intact: A hemispheric celestial globe with intact brass meridian rings, complete star lamp beads, able to rotate evenly to demonstrate precession.
states.gear_jammed: The same celestial globe with gears jammed; star lamp beads half-lit; meridian ring skewed stuck.
states.recalibrated: After recalibration the celestial globe rotates smooth again, but a shallow repair weld remains on the base, distinct from the first intact state.

states.intact: A deep-blue leather star-script book filled with show cues and pointing coordinates, cover clean.
states.coffee_stained: The same star-script book coffee-stained; cover swollen, writing bled, a crumpled blotting sheet tucked in.

states.intact: A raisable commentary lift platform with intact rails and nonslip tread, able to rise to mid-dome for commentary.
states.crashed: The commentary lift platform cables snapped and crashed; rails twisted—only skewed wreckage left.

states.young_rival: Achen whose face and build closely resemble Axing's, but an amber star brooch, flamboyant and fond of grabbing the mic.
states.remade_face: After remaking the look, Achen still wears the amber star brooch, plus thin-frame glasses, expression deeper.

segments.action: At dusk, Gu Heng pushes open the dome planetarium side door and pins the Big Dipper badge firm.
Inside the dome planetarium hang a row of five track spotlights; Gu Heng polishes each one.
Two opening cue bells hang by the door; Gu Heng reaches to make them chime softly.
Gu Heng circles the celestial globe checking every brass meridian ring and star lamp bead.
Gu Heng looks up as the dome's false starfield gradually brightens.
The intact celestial globe rotates evenly at hall center; track spotlights sweep the star points.
On the show sheet Gu Heng adds tonight's winter sky show and interactive Q&A slot.
Gu Heng takes the badge off and pins it back, confirming the clasp is tight.
Gu Heng sorts scattered laser-pointer batteries and restacks them by show.
Gu Heng sits in a front-row seat and rubs his sore neck and shoulders.
Gu Heng opens the star-script book and writes tonight's constellation projections and cues by show.
Beside the Big Dipper pointing section he draws a blue star mark, reminding himself to dim half the dome lights.
Gu Heng closes the star-script book and clips it back into the lectern side pocket.
Reflection from the celestial globe sweeps Gu Heng's profile.
Checking the celestial globe, Gu Heng circles with red pen a meridian mark that turns a little slow.
Gu Heng returns the laser pointer and spare mic to the charging cradle so they will not roll into seat gaps.
In the morning front-hall star-map gallery, Gu Heng greets young Axing arriving with the commentary lift platform.
Axing pushes the commentary lift platform to the gallery edge and locks the casters.
Gu Heng points to three seat-number glow tags and teaches Axing to mark interactive seats and question order with them.
Axing crouches in the front-hall star-map gallery, looking up at constellation reliefs mirrored in the floor tiles.
Gu Heng explains the rules: after the opening bell dim lights, point Big Dipper before turning the Milky Way, stop the platform before guests stand.
Axing glances back at the intact commentary lift platform, eyes full of longing.
Gu Heng has Axing grip the rail and practice an emergency stop before rising to mid-dome.
Axing tightens the turmeric armband and silently recites Gu Heng's three opening lines beside the script.
In the equipment mezzanine, Achen with an amber star brooch turns to look from the dark.
